title: AI Builds the Websites That Pay You Monthly
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Hostinger Horizons, domains, and hosting are prominently demonstrated; the transcript does not establish whether this is sponsored or affiliated.

stated_problem.quote: local service businesses are generally terrible at internet marketing.

idea.name: Rank and rent local lead generation
idea.one_liner: Build and rank local service websites, then sell the incoming enquiries to service companies.

acquisition_channels.details: Optimize local service pages for organic search; the host also recommends backlinks and a Google Business Profile.
Reach out to a service business after leads arrive and offer the first leads free; the outreach method is not stated.

prices: tens or even hundreds of dollars
